name: The Bird and the Rabbit
source:
Juniper is a young harpy who works as a guard in a trading post. She has fought hard to earn everything she has in a world ripe with racial prejudice. When she one day meets a rabbit-eared stranger with tales that defy everything she thought she knew about the outside world, she begins to question the value of her position. Should she risk it all for the chance at a new life?

The Bird and the Rabbit is a visual novel about the struggles of experiencing oppression on an intersectional level. When you understand the context of your decisions, your outlook on the world changes, forcing you to think beyond the objective and consider emotional repercussions.

[From [url=http://globalgamejam.org/2014/games/bird-and-rabbit]Global Game Jam[/url]]
translation:
杜松是一个年轻的鹰身女妖，在贸易站担任守卫。在一个充满种族偏见的世界里，她努力奋斗，赢得了自己所拥有的一切。有一天，当她遇到一位长着兔耳的陌生人时，她所讲述的故事与她自以为对外部世界所了解的一切相悖，她开始质疑自己职位的价值。她应该冒一切风险去换取新生活的机会吗？

《鸟和兔子》是一部视觉小说，讲述了在交叉层面上经历压迫的挣扎。当你了解决策的背景时，你的世界观就会发生变化，迫使你超越目标进行思考并考虑情感影响。

[来自[url=http://globalgamejam.org/2014/games/bird-and-rabbit]全球游戏嘉年华[/url]]
